text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pencegahan Pengubahan
Wang Haram, Pencegahan Pembiayaan Keganasan dan Hasil daripada Aktiviti
Haram (Penggunaan Bahagian IV) (Pindaan) 2018.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2019.

Penggantian perenggan 2

2. Perintah Pencegahan Pengubahan Wang Haram  dan Pencegahan Pembiayaan
Keganasan (Penggunaan Bahagian IV) 2010 [ P.U. (A) 403/2010] dipinda dengan
menggantikan perenggan 2 dengan perenggan yang berikut:

 "Penggunaan perenggan 14(1)(a)
2. Peruntukan perenggan 14(1) (a) Akta hendaklah digunakan berkenaan
dengan institusi yang berlesen atau berdaftar untuk menjalankan perniagaan
perjudian di bawah Akta Rumah Perjudian Terbuka 1953.".

Disyorkan 19 Disember 2018

DATUK NOR SHAMSIAH MOHD YUNUS
Pihak Berkuasa Berwibawa

Dibuat 19 Disember 2018
[MOF.SID(S)700-1/2/2 (SK.1); BNM.JUN.1125/3603; PN(PU2)622/XXVI]

LIM GUAN ENG
Menteri Kewangan

ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING, ANTI-TERRORISM FINANCING AND
PROCEEDS OF UNLAWFUL ACTIVITIES ACT 2001

ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING, ANTI-TERRORISM FINANCING AND PROCEEDS OF
UNLAWFUL ACTIVITIES (INVOCATION OF PART IV) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 8 (1) of the
Anti-Money Laundering, Anti -Terrorism Financing and Proceeds of Unlawful Activities
Act 2001 [Act 613], the Minister of Finance, upon the recommendation of the competent
authority which has consulted the Ministry of Finance as the relevant supervisory
authority of the reporting institutions  that carry on the activities carried out by a
common gaming house as defined in the Common Gaming Houses Act 1953 [ Act 289 ],
